title: Non-Gaussianity of the Stagnation Law in Particle Swarm Optimization
summary: We study one-dimensional particle swarm optimization during stagnation, with two fixed distinct attractors and equal independent uniform acceleration ranges. The position then satisfies a second-order random affine recurrence. For inertia $w$ and acceleration range $c$, we prove that throughout the open mean-square stability region \[ -1 0,\qquad 12(1-w^2)-c(7-5w)>0, \] no invariant position marginal, and hence no limiting position marginal, can be Gaussian.
